content: This document provides a summary of information about the product and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Before using ceftolozane/tazobactam, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to cephalosporins, penicillins, or other antibiotics, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Additionally, this medication contains sodium. Ceftolozane/tazobactam may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as specific urine glucose tests, potentially causing false results. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms like loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as complete blood counts and kidney function tests, may be performed while you are using this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly for a new dosing schedule. For storage, refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. Always consult your healthcare provider for the most up-to-date and complete information about this product and your health needs.
